facts.fact: States/UTs must recover PM-KISAN money paid to ineligible farmers, such as income-tax payers, PSU and State/Central Government employees and constitutional post holders
facts.quote: States/UTs have been mandated to recover funds disbursed to ineligible farmers such as individuals belonging to higher-income groups, income tax payees, employees of PSUs, State/Central Govt., Constitutional post holders etc.

facts.fact: A beneficiary who gave an incorrect self-declaration is liable to repay the benefit received and to penal action
facts.quote: In case of incorrect self declaration, beneficiary shall be liable for recovery of transferred financial benefit and other penal actions as per law.

facts.fact: The pmkisan.gov.in Farmers Corner has an 'Online Refund' option
facts.quote: Know Your Status Update Mobile Number Online Refund Voluntary Surrender of PM Kisan Benefits

facts.fact: Contact details of the State Nodal Officers and a Help-Desk are on the pmkisan.gov.in Contact Us page
facts.quote: Contact Details of State Nodal Officers Searchable Contact Details Help-Desk

behaviour: Explains, citing pmkisan.gov.in / PIB, that PM-KISAN money is recovered from beneficiaries found ineligible (e.g. income-tax payers, government employees) or who gave an incorrect self-declaration; does not judge the user's own case; routes the user to the State Nodal Officer / Help-Desk on pmkisan.gov.in (or the PM-KISAN helpline) to find out the reason and, if due, the 'Online Refund' option.
fail_if: It says the notice must be fake or can be ignored, decides the user's case, or cites no official page.
summary: Added the recovery rules (PIB: States/UTs recover from ineligible farmers; Operational Guidelines: incorrect declaration liable for recovery) and the portal routes (Online Refund, State Nodal Officers, Help-Desk).
